title: Video Shoots and Production for New York City Brands
metaTitle: Video Shoots and Production in New York City | TDM
metaDescription: Video shoots for New York City brands: concept and scripts by TDM, filming by our team in the United States, editing at our Lahore office. Free consultation.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) plans, scripts and films video shoots for New York City brands and delivers the finished videos: brand films, product videos and footage for ads and social. Our team in the United States runs the shoot on location or wherever suits the project. The footage then goes to our operations office in Lahore for editing, grading and versioning, and you approve the treatment beforehand and the cuts afterwards.

sections.heading: What filming in New York demands
paragraphs: New York is one of the most filmed cities anywhere, and viewers know its skyline, bridges and brownstone blocks on sight. That helps a brand that belongs here, but footage that only shows the city says nothing about the business.

Practical limits shape every shoot. Interiors are small, so a restaurant kitchen or a boutique leaves little room for lights and people. Streets are loud, with sirens, traffic and construction, which makes clean sound outdoors hard to get. Scaffolding can cover a storefront for months. Winter days are short and cold, and summers are hot and humid. Filming with only a handheld camera on a public pavement is treated differently from a setup with equipment, vehicles or a closed-off area, which generally requires a permit from the city's film office. Parks and private buildings have their own rules, and many buildings ask for proof of insurance before a camera comes through the door.

sections.heading: How we organise a shoot
paragraphs: We begin with what the footage must do: which ads, pages and channels it will feed. From that we write treatments, scripts and storyboards for your approval. Pre-production then fixes casting, locations, props, wardrobe and a shot-by-shot schedule. Our team in the United States then films against the approved shot list, and the footage goes directly to our editors in Lahore.

Because TDM also runs advertising and social media, the shot list is written backwards from distribution. It names the opening hooks an ad account needs to test, the demonstrations a product page lacks and the b-roll a content calendar will use.
bullets: Scripts and on-screen text approved before the day, so time on location is not spent deciding what to say.
Permit, insurance and building-access questions raised in pre-production, before a date is fixed.
Quiet hours identified for each location, such as before service in a restaurant or before opening in a shop.
Editing, grading and versioning by the same team that wrote the plan.

sections.heading: When the city does not need to be in the frame
paragraphs: A candle, a serum, a handbag or a kitchen gadget can be filmed anywhere. For product-led videos, our US-based team films the items on a tabletop set or in a setting chosen for the brief, with no city location to book. Filming in the city makes sense when the place or the people are the point: a dining room, a showroom, an apartment for sale, a clinic, a founder at work.

sections.heading: Points to agree before any shoot is booked
paragraphs: Decide where the videos will be used before choosing a date. Ask who is responsible for permits, location releases and insurance certificates. Ask whether editing is included or whether you will be handed raw files. Confirm how many finished videos you will receive, in which lengths and formats.

faqs.q: Who films a TDM video shoot in New York City?
faqs.a: Our team in the United States. They run the shoot on location or wherever suits the project, and the footage is edited at our operations office in Lahore.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit to film in New York City?
faqs.a: It depends on the setup. Handheld filming on public pavements is generally treated differently from shoots that use equipment, vehicles or exclusive use of public space, which generally need a permit from the city's film office. Parks and private property have separate rules. We check what applies during pre-production.

faqs.q: How much does a video shoot cost in New York City?
faqs.a: It depends on scope: locations, talent, shoot days and the number of finished videos. We quote after a free consultation, once the purpose of the footage and the shot list are clear.

faqs.q: How far ahead should a shoot be planned?
faqs.a: It depends on the brief, the locations and the people involved, and the schedule is agreed in the plan.

faqs.q: Can you make product videos without filming in New York?
faqs.a: Yes. When the product is the subject and the city is not, our US-based team films it in a setting that fits the treatment.
